Results.ReviewText:
I initially bought a Spirit II grill and was very disappointed with it's ability to heat above 450F, went threw multiple iterations of remote trouble shooting unsuccessfully, replace the regulator, etc, etc. still no improvements.

So I inquired as to what could be done to return the current unit and replace it with a Genesis, like what we have had for 10+ years at our primary residence and were informed that is not possible.  After finally getting to the right level of support, we proposition was made to purchase a new Genesis for the highly discounted price of $500, MSRP ~$800, and complimentary cover and a free accessory.  We took Weber up on the offer and also took advantage of their flat fee $99 assembly service via Angi.  Everything went as planned, the grill was promptly shipped, the assembler showed up on time and did a great job (we got stuck with have to bring all the packaging to the dump) and we now have a new Genesis, with a Cover and Griddle and managed to sell the original unit of FB Marketplace for $250 - all in all a GREAT OUTCOME and EXCELLENT Customer Service - WELL DONE WEBER!
Results.Title: Weber made it right!

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
